plan.title: 坂田銀時 (Sakata Gintoki)
plan.summary: A high-mobility melee fighter who balances 'Dead Fish Eyes' comedy with high-impact counter-attacks. He excels at punishing aggressive enemies with his wooden sword, utilizing a unique 'Lazy Counter' mechanic that rewards timing over raw aggression.

slots.name: 死魚眼的直覺 (Dead Fish Eyes Intuition)
slots.purpose: Provides a chance to ignore minor CC and grants a 'Lazy' stack when dodging.

slots.name: 木刀揮擊 (Wooden Sword Swing)
slots.purpose: Standard melee strike with a chance to apply a 'Mark' for the next counter.

slots.name: 隨便啦！ (Whatever!)
slots.purpose: A short dash that leaves a 'Lazy' trail. If used while 'Lazy' stacks are active, it grants a brief shield.

slots.name: 反擊：木刀防禦 (Counter: Wooden Sword Defense)
slots.purpose: Enter a defensive stance. If hit by a melee attack, perform a massive counter-strike and reset the cooldown.

slots.name: 銀魂的日常 (Daily Life of Gintoki)
slots.purpose: Taunt all nearby enemies and enter a 'Comedy' state. For 3 seconds, all damage taken is reduced by 50%, and every attack deals bonus damage based on 'Lazy' stacks.

slots.name: 真面目 (Serious Mode)
slots.purpose: Instantly consume all 'Lazy' stacks to perform a devastating series of strikes in a line, dealing massive damage and knocking back enemies.

champion.name: 坂田銀時
champion.description: A samurai who protects the people of Edo with a wooden sword and a lazy attitude. He fights with a mix of high-level swordsmanship and comedic timing.

PASSIVE.name: 死魚眼的直覺
PASSIVE.description: Dodging an attack grants a 'Lazy' stack. At 3 stacks, the next dash (W) provides a shield.

Q.name: 木刀揮擊
Q.description: A quick strike with the wooden sword. Marks the target for a potential counter.

W.name: 隨便啦！
W.description: Dash forward. If 'Lazy' stacks are full, gain a shield upon arrival.

E.name: 反擊：木刀防禦
E.description: Enter a defensive stance. If hit by a melee attack, perform a massive counter-strike and reset the cooldown.

R.name: 銀魂的日常
R.description: Taunt nearby enemies. For 3 seconds, reduce damage taken and increase damage output based on 'Lazy' stacks.

EX.name: 真面目
EX.description: Consume all 'Lazy' stacks to unleash a devastating line strike.
